snowflake-horizon:rest-spec-support:curr.notes: Horizon Catalog exposes the Iceberg REST API with Apache Polaris integrated: external engines read and write Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables with vended credentials.
caveats: Writes from external engines to v3 tables through Horizon Catalog aren't supported yet

snowflake-horizon:v2-spec-support:curren.notes: Format v2 is the baseline for Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables; GET_DDL reports ICEBERG_VERSION = 2 for v2 tables.

snowflake-horizon:v3-spec-support:curren.notes: Iceberg v3 GA since May 2026 with the full v3 surface: geography, geometry, nanosecond timestamp and variant types plus default values, deletion vectors and row lineage.
caveats: Reading v3 tables via the Horizon IRC endpoint is GA, but external-engine writes to v3 tables aren't supported yet

snowflake-horizon:managed-offering:curre.notes: Fully managed SaaS with zero catalog operations.

snowflake-horizon:serves-own-irc:current.notes: Read and write GA over the built-in Apache Polaris IRC endpoint (Iceberg spec v2 and v3).

snowflake-horizon:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: Catalog-linked databases read and write externally-governed Iceberg tables over IRC.

snowflake-horizon:federation-broker:curr.notes: Consuming external catalogs is GA (catalog-linked databases over Glue, Unity and Open Catalog); the full broker path, serving those foreign tables back out to external engines over its own IRC, is not yet publicly GA.

snowflake-horizon:multi-engine-multi-clo.notes: Spark, Flink, Trino, DuckDB, Dremio, StarRocks, PyIceberg and Doris; S3, GCS and Azure storage.

snowflake-horizon:governance-cred-vendin.notes: Credential vending over IRC; masking and row-access policies are enforced even on external-engine reads.
